collection.description: Fictional format and judgment demonstration. Six hand-authored rows, not a collected or representative sample.

reviews.title: A stopping point
reviews.text: I used to keep scrolling after the kids were asleep. Ten minutes with my headphones gives the evening a stopping point.

reviews.title: On the train
reviews.text: I download one before the journey. It is useful when the train loses signal, although I wish the download were easier to find.

reviews.title: Not ready when I needed it
reviews.text: The download failed before my train left. The session would not play when I lost signal.

reviews.title: Expected a person
reviews.text: I thought I would get a coach who knew my situation. It is a library of recordings.

reviews.title: Before the meeting
reviews.text: I listen to a short session before a presentation. I still feel nervous, but it gives me something to do besides rehearse the same first sentence.

reviews.title: Know what you are buying
reviews.text: I liked the recordings. I did not realize a subscription followed the trial, so I cancelled.
